Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game and we are already two games down in this Tri-Series, with Pakistan coming out trumps in both matches. Next up, it will be the home side, United Arab Emirates taking on Afghanistan at the same venue on Monday, 1st September. That game will begin at 3 pm GMT but you can always tune in sooner for the build-up. Cheers!

The victorious captain of Pakistan, SALMAN AGHA, reflects that they batted really well. Admits that they bowled with control in the first 15 overs, but leaked runs in the last five. Stresses that it is one area where they are focusing on improving. Appreciates Hasan Nawaz and calls him a generational talent with a great future. Adds that he just needs to keep working on his game. Stresses to get better in the death bowling and feels the need to do better in the next game. Ends by adding that he wants his side to play an aggressive brand of cricket.

The skipper of United Arab Emirates, MUHAMMAD WASEEM says that the team gave away 15-20 runs extra in the first innings but appreciates the fight from the batters to keep the game alive till the end. Speaks highly about the performance from Asif Khan and feels lucky to have a talent like him in their team. And also points out that, they need to mix their bowlers a bit and would look to bounce back in the upcoming matches.

Pakistan's SAIM AYUB is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his fine knock of 69 off just 38 deliveries. He says that it's pleasing to see different players performing at different times. Says he does not like individual awards and calls them overrated, as cricket is a team game. Adds that it is all about the execution, to pick the length and wait for the bad balls. Shares that he is working on his bowling and is getting better at it. On how difficult it is to maintain consistency in T20 cricket, he says you just need to keep your thought process clear.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Pakistan won the toss and opted to set the tone with the bat. That is exactly what Saim Ayub did with a half-century and just like the previous game, Pakistan has a substantial contribution from at least one of their openers, which laid the foundation of things to come. Hasan Nawaz was the enforcer in the middle order and he too scored a half-century, helping his side breach the 200-run mark. Saghir Khan and Junaid Siddique picked up three wickets each but they were expensive and no UAE bowler really was able to put the brakes on Pakistan's charge.

UAE will look back at this contest and feel that they could have actually pulled off an upset here. Pakistan's bowling lineup was weakened and the UAE skipper, Muhammad Waseem, provided his team with a quick start. However, the rest of the top order failed to make an impact as Asif Khan played a lone and substantial hand in the second half of the chase. Unfortunately, his exploits weren't enough for the home side to get over the line.

Pakistan had the runs on the board and a few wickets up top were all they needed. The first wicket didn't come early on but once it came, their bowlers pounced on the opportunity and exposed the middle order of the UAE. The spinners did a fine job, especially Mohammad Nawaz, who was economical and picked up a couple of wickets as well. Without the likes of Shaheen Afridi and Haris Rauf in the lineup, the death bowling wasn't at its best but they had done enough to ensure a comfortable victory. And, Hasan Ali did end proceedings with a couple of wickets in the final over, even though he was expensive overall.
Pakistan make it two wins out of two to kickstart this Tri-Series and they are now in a dominant position. United Arab Emirates open their account with a loss and are in the same boat as Afghanistan.

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS BREAK. With 39 on the board, and the scoring rate in the vicinity of 10 runs per over, it looked like the United Arab Emirates could throw a huge challenge to Pakistan. Muhammad Waseem showed his muscle and got them off to a really positive start, but him getting run out at the most inopportune time opened the floodgates and UAE slipped down to 68/4 in no time. And since the restrictions have lifted, Pakistan have conceded just 21 runs in the last four overs. A lot will depend on Rahul Chopra now. He will have to dig deep and stay till the end to get the game closer. Here's Mohammad Nawaz back into the attack after the break.

Commentary.Commentary: Rahul Chopra is in at 5. Saim Ayub is into the attack now.

OUT! GONE! CAUGHT BEHIND! Two in two for Hasan Ali! Ali bends his back and bowls the effort delivery into the surface. Targets the bodyline, and the ball skids off the surface as well. Ethan D'souza doesn't read the pace behind it and gets late to play the pull shot. The ball hits the gloves and goes behind to the right of the keeper. Mohammad Haris dives full-stretch to his right and completes the catch. From 54/1, United Arab Emirates have slipped down to 54/3 at the end of the Powerplay, needing 154 runs to win.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Hasan Ali
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Hasan Ali to Ethan D'souza, OUT! c Mohammad Haris b Hasan Ali.

Commentary.Commentary: Alishan Sharafu is in at 4.

OUT! RUN OUT! A waste of a wicket and this is a massive blow to the home team! Short from Hasan, on the bodyline, Ethan D'souza pulls it to mid-wicket. The fielder there fumbles and the ball is parried behind. The batters call for the second and complete. With the fielder from long on, getting to the ball by running to his left, Ethan sniffs the third run and calls Waseem for it. The throw arrives at Hasan Ali, with Waseem struggling to make his ground. Hasan collects it and throws the ball into the stumps at the non-striker's end. The replay shows that even the dive from Waseem couldn't save him as he is caught short of his crease. Muhammad Waseem is distraught and trudges off for a fine 33 off just 18. United Arab Emirates are 54/2.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Hasan Ali to Ethan D'souza, OUT! run out (Mohammad Nawaz / Hasan Ali).

Commentary.Commentary: Ali pulls his length back, seeing Muhammad Waseem skips down the track and follows him up on leg. Muhammad Waseem gets cramped up for the room and ends up bunting it towards mid off and takes a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Hasan Ali to Muhammad Waseem, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a hard length, around off, Muhammad Waseem cuts it through cover-point for a single. This brings up the 50 for United Arab Emirates!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Hasan Ali to Muhammad Waseem, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: The length is pulled back and the pace is taken off this time. On a length, on top of middle. Waseem again backs away and tries to cut it square on the off side, but the ball just kicks up a bit to beat the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Hasan Ali to Muhammad Waseem, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! THAT IS MASSIVE! The skipper showing his muscle! Hasan Ali serves a juicy half volley, on middle. Muhammad Waseem shuffles to the leg side to create space for himself. Gets his bat right under the ball and hoists it downtown for a massive six. Waseem moves to 30 off just 16 balls!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Hasan Ali to Muhammad Waseem, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and around off, turns into the batter. Ethan D'souza strides forward and defends it. Good over from Mohammad Nawaz, just 4 runs off it and a wicket as well.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Mohammad Nawaz to Ethan D'souza, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Spears it full and around the stumps, Muhammad Waseem lunges forward to drop it beside the deck on the leg side, and sets off for a quick single. Mohammad Nawaz chases it on the follow-through and does well to reach for it. A single is taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Keeps it flatter and attacks the stumps. Muhammad Waseem doesn't read the length and sits down the play the sweep shot. The ball catches the inside edge and deflects onto the pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Lands safe! Floated fuller and outside off. Muhammad Waseem is lured in the flight, backs away and lofts it inside out over cover. However, with the lack of timing the ball goes only as far as deep extra cover and plugs in the field. Two taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Touch full and on the leg stump, Ethan D'souza clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Mohammad Nawaz to Ethan D'souza, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ethan D'souza is in at 3.

OUT! GONE! CAUGHT! Mohammad Nawaz with the first breakthrough for Pakistan. He bowls from around the stumps and drags the length, short and on middle, giving less space to work with for Zohaib. The southpaw is hurried to go deep inside the crease to make room for himself, but mistimes it flat and off the toe end of the bat. Hits it straight to Hasan Nawaz at cover who takes a simple catch. Muhammad Zohaib goes for 13 (14) and the United Arab Emirates are 39/1.
Commentary.Howout: c Hasan Nawaz b Mohammad Nawaz
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Zohaib, OUT! c Hasan Nawaz b Mohammad Nawaz.

Commentary.Commentary: Change? Nope. Mohammad Nawaz (1-0-9-) to continue.

Pushed across the right-hander, on a length and around off. Muhammad Waseem looks to play that away from the body and gets a thick outside edge as the ball goes towards short third. A dot to finish off from Salman Mirza.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Waseem, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls around the pads line, length delivery, Muhammad Waseem holds his shape to clip that to the right of short fine leg. Hasan Ali chases it down and cuts it off. Two runs taken in the meantime.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Waseem, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: On top of off, on a length, Muhammad Zohaib chops it to backward point and sets off for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Zohaib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length, on off, Muhammad Zohaib knocks it straight to mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Zohaib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! Ordinary bowling this, and runs are flowing for the UAE! Way too short, climbing over the batter's head height. Muhammad Zohaib sways away from the line and ducks. The ball flies over the leaping Mohammad Haris behind the stumps and races away to the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Zohaib, 5 Wides!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, jagging back in a touch. Muhammad Zohaib gets right behind the line and blocks it watchfully.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Zohaib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is a very positive start for the hosts! Mirza feeds in a half volley around off. Muhammad Zohaib climbs over it and smashes it over cover for a cracking boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Salman Mirza to Muhammad Zohaib, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Switch of ends for Salman Mirza. He is 1-0-6-0 so far and replaces Hasan Ali.

Bowls it a bit slower this time, a touch fuller and outside off, gets the ball to turn away. Muhammad Waseem gets down to play the sweep again, but gets beaten by the spin and bounce. 9 runs off Mohammad Nawaz's first over. 21 runs off the last two overs for the United Arab Emirates!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This time on the other side of the square! Fractionally short, outside off from Mohammad Nawaz. Muhammad Waseem gets back and punches it in the gap between cover and point for four more runs. Mohammad Nawaz gets a bit predictable on this occasion.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Swept across perfectly! Mohammad Nawaz drops it fuller and straighter at the stumps, with not much spin on it. Muhammad Waseem sits down and nails the sweep shot to beat the square leg fielder on his right for four runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: A huge, prolonged appeal for LBW, but not entertained. Pitching outside leg? An in-drifter, landing somewhere around the leg stump line, and turns away to the middle stump. Waseem is forced to draw his front foot out and tries to push it away, but plays all over it and is struck on the front pad. The replay shows that it just might have pitched outside leg.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Waseem, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Drag-downer, on the leg stump. Muhammad Zohaib knocks it to the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Zohaib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and shorter, across off, on a length. Zohaib backs away and punches it straight to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Mohammad Nawaz to Muhammad Zohaib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Spin introduced with Mohammad Nawaz. He replaces Salman Mirza.

SIX! Takes the aerial route! Hasan Ali stays on the shorter side and bowls it at the stumps. Muhammad Waseem climbs on it, and just smashes it uppishly over the backward point region for half a dozen. 12 runs off the Hasan Ali over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Hasan Ali to Muhammad Waseem, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! UP AND OVER! Hasan Ali keeps it short and around middle. Muhammad Waseem steps out and stays on the leg side to slap it over mid off for four runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Hasan Ali to Muhammad Waseem, Four!

No run. Full and just outside off, firmly driven to cover. Tidy start from Salman Mirza. Just 6 off the opening over.

Muhammad Zohaib goes to play that on the off side with hard hands and ends up chopping the inside edge. The ball shoots over the stumps and races behind to the fine leg fence to beat the keeper on his right for the first boundary.

Commentary.Commentary: Digs in a sharp short ball towards the right shoulder of Muhammad Zohaib, who sets up for the pull but the ball skids on to hit the gloves and dribbles towards short fine for a dot.

Luckily for him, the ball lands in the safe zone and is chased by one of the fielders from the inner ring. Two taken. UAE and Zohaib are off the mark in the chase.
